zechariah.8.p1.b1.text: I am jealous for Zion with great zeal … Then Jerusalem will be called the City of Truth, and the mountain of the LORD of Hosts will be called the Holy Mountain.

zechariah.8.p1.b2.text: Old men and old women will again sit along the streets of Jerusalem, each with a staff in hand because of great age. And the streets of the city will be filled with boys and girls playing there.

zechariah.8.p1.b3.text: I will save My people from the land of the east and from the land of the west. … where they will be My people, and I will be their faithful and righteous God.

zechariah.8.p1.b4.text: … Let your hands be strong, you who now hear these words

zechariah.8.p1.b5.text: the vine will yield its fruit, the ground will yield its produce, and the skies will give their dew. … Do not be afraid; let your hands be strong.

zechariah.8.p2.b1.text: These are the things you must do: Speak truth to one another, render true and sound judgments in your gates

zechariah.8.p2.b2.text: The fasts of the fourth, the fifth, the seventh, and the tenth months will become times of joy and gladness, cheerful feasts for the house of Judah …

zechariah.8.p2.b3.text: Let us go at once to plead before the LORD and to seek the LORD of Hosts. I myself am going.

zechariah.8.p2.b4.text: Let us go with you, for we have heard that God is with you.
